title: EventBus callback self-unregister + self-register during delivery contract

contract.combined_mutation: A callback can unregister itself and register another callback during active event delivery
contract.current_delivery_isolation: The newly registered callback does not receive the already-active event
contract.current_delivery_continuity: Combined unregister/register mutation does not interrupt existing callback delivery
contract.old_callback_removal: The self-unregistered callback is removed from the listener registry
contract.new_callback_activation: The newly registered callback becomes active for subsequent emits
contract.delivery_order_preservation: Existing callbacks preserve their active delivery order
contract.registry_stability: Combined callback mutation does not corrupt the listener registry
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after combined callback mutation
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus operations require the events permission
